title: Switching encoding
statement: Let $n,w,k$ be natural numbers and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates whose width is at most $w$. The switching encoding maps each coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula has decision-tree depth at least $k+1$ to a pair consisting of a coordinate restriction and a switching code of width $w$ and index $k+1$.
